heading: Orange County Democrats are standing with Roberta.
text: Democratic leaders from across Orange County came together to deliver a clear message: this election should be about character, qualifications, experience, integrity, and who is truly prepared to lead the Clerk of Court on Day One.

heading: Orange County Democrats are standing with Roberta.
text: State Senator LaVon Bracy Davis — who has known Roberta for more than two decades, and who made history alongside her in the inaugural graduating class of the re-established Florida A&M University College of Law — spoke to the dignity and strength Roberta has shown throughout this campaign.

heading: Orange County Democrats are standing with Roberta.
text: “Pressure doesn’t create character. Pressure reveals it.” “While voters can’t object, they can reject.”

heading: Orange County Democrats are standing with Roberta.
text: Senator Bracy Davis was joined by Congressman Maxwell Alejandro Frost, Senator Carlos Guillermo Smith, Representative Anna V. Eskamani, Representative RaShon Young, and other Democratic leaders calling for a campaign focused on qualifications, experience, and readiness to serve.

heading: The first face of justice for our community.
text: The Clerk's Office is more than a government office. It is the heartbeat of our local justice system. For many residents, the Clerk's Office is the very first face of justice they encounter during some of the most important, emotional, and life-changing moments of their lives.

heading: The first face of justice for our community.
text: The Clerk's Office is responsible for protecting court records, supporting our justice partners, managing the court registry, and ensuring all residents have meaningful access to justice.

heading: A campaign built on service, not slogans.
text: Roberta is running to ensure the office remains grounded in professionalism, accessibility, innovation, accountability, and trusted leadership, with the competence, compassion, and clear understanding of how the Clerk's Office impacts the daily lives of Orange County residents.

heading: Access to Justice
text: Every resident deserves dignity, respect, professionalism, and compassion when they interact with the Clerk's Office.

heading: Modern Technology
text: Innovate and rebrand our offices as a technology-forward service provider built for our growing population.

heading: Public Records Integrity
text: Safeguard official court records, protect public funds, and uphold the highest standard of data quality.

heading: Community & Court Connection
text: Build community education partnerships that strengthen public trust and help residents navigate the courts.

heading: A legal career built in service of Orange County.
text: From legal aid to General Counsel for the Clerk of Court, Roberta has spent her career making the justice system work for the people who depend on it. The cards on the right cycle through the milestones see the full picture for the details behind each chapter.

heading: Attorney, Access to Justice
text: Community Legal Services of Mid-Florida, Inc.

heading: What does the Clerk of Court actually do?
text: Most residents never hear about the Clerk of Court until they need it. Roberta takes the time to explain the office in plain language — what it handles, how it protects your records, and why it matters to every family in Orange County.

heading: What does the Clerk of Court actually do?
text: Watch the full video series to learn how the office works and what experienced leadership looks like.

heading: Your Connection to the Courts
text: Bridging Justice and Community, a platform built on professionalism, accessibility, innovation, and accountability.

heading: Expand Access to Court and Prioritize the Customer Experience
text: Every person who interacts with the Clerk's Office should be treated with dignity, respect, and professionalism. Roberta will lead a customer-centered Clerk's Office that meets people where they are and removes barriers to accessing the courts.

heading: Improve Efficiency and Modern Technology Solutions
text: Orange County is growing, and the Clerk's Office must grow with it. Roberta will champion innovation and technology-forward service so the office is efficient today and prepared for the needs of tomorrow.

heading: Protect the Integrity of Public Records and the Quality of Court Data
text: The Clerk is the official keeper of the court's records and the steward of public funds. Roberta will safeguard court records, protect public dollars, and uphold the data quality that the public, the bar, and the bench rely on.

heading: Connect the Community and the Courts through Civic Engagement & Court Literacy
text: Roberta will lead community education partnerships that help residents understand how their courts work for them, building public trust between the Clerk's Office and every neighborhood it serves.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 1 Build community education partnerships for residents navigating complex, quality-of-life issues.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 2 Report important data analytics to improve public trust and governmental accountability.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 3 Innovate and rebrand our offices as a technology-forward service provider.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 4 Develop customer-centered service tools for our growing population and multilingual communities.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 5 Guard and steward our trusted public records.

heading: What Roberta will do as your Clerk of Court.
text: 6 Establish a community-focused gateway to our courts.

heading: Introduction
text: The Roberta Walton Johnson campaign ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our campaign website or interact with our online services.

heading: Information We Collect
text: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, mailing address, and other contact details. This information is typically collected when you sign up to volunteer, request information, make a donation, subscribe to our newsletter, or otherwise engage with our campaign.

heading: How We Use Your Information
text: We use the information we collect to communicate with you about the campaign, send updates and newsletters, coordinate volunteer activities, process donations, respond to inquiries, and comply with legal obligations. We may also use your information to improve our website and outreach efforts.

heading: Sharing Your Information
text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for commercial purposes. We may share information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and campaign operations, subject to confidentiality obligations. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights.

heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
text: Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze site traffic, and understand how visitors interact with our content. You can adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies; however, this may affect the functionality of certain features.

heading: Data Security
text: We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data, no method of transmission over the internet is entirely secure.

heading: Your Choices
text: You may opt out of receiving communications from us at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions included in our emails or by contacting us directly. You may also request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by reaching out to our campaign.

heading: Third Party Links
text: Our website may contain links to third party websites, including donation platforms and social media sites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites and encourage you to review their respective privacy policies.

heading: Changes to This Policy
text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. We encourage you to review this page periodically for the latest information on our privacy practices.

heading: Contact Us
text: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us through the "Get Connected" page on this website.
